name: UA-PlantNeRF Architecture
definition: A unified framework that reconstructs a volumetric radiance field $R$, a spatially varying uncertainty field $U$, and provides conformal prediction intervals, addressing degraded geometry under sparse views and lack of uncertainty estimates.
summary: UA-PlantNeRF is a dual-head NeRF framework for plant volumetric reconstruction that jointly predicts density, color, and decomposed uncertainty to prevent geometry collapse in occluded regions.
